0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, first in the Pacific and third in the West) host the Trail Blazers (2-0, second in the Northwest and one game back in the division), with Los Angeles on a three-game winning streak and 2-0 at home. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, and the Lakers lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, most recently 132-116 in Portland on January 17, 2026.
